'''Fondor Belt II''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]], located in the [[Freeworlds Territory]] portion of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], within the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]]. Along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|star system]], the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] belt was located along the [[Gandeal-Fondor Hyperlane]],<ref name="TEA" /> with another [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] connecting it to the [[Sefon system/Legends|Sefon system]].<ref name="LotE">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Fondor system/Legends|Fondor system]]</ref> The asteroid belt occupied the third [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Fondor (star)|Fondor]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fondor Belt II was mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-13.<ref name="TEA" />
